capabilities: Show a colour-coded minimap or scrollbar beside each note
Jump to any position by dragging or tapping the bar
Show the current page in a bubble while scrolling
Pinch to zoom note text on touch screens
Bookmark pages and jump to them across notes and tabs
extras: Full Screen Guard and Note zoom are experimental or off by default; some features (Find, tab arrows, Full Screen Guard) are phone/tablet only. Update checks contact GitHub releases only; the plugin collects no data.
problem: Obsidian has no minimap or compact scroll overview for long notes, and navigating them is awkward on phones with only the built-in scrollbar.

relations.evidence: It was a separate plugin and is now built in.
Tab Arrows 2.0.0 merged in, with all its options and animations.

summary: Scrollbar or colour-coded minimap beside each note with drag-to-navigate, a page bubble, and mobile extras like pinch zoom and page bookmarks.
